paragraphs: Rav Yeimar, son of Rav Hillel.
He is mentioned in Zevachim 9a, and Rava responds to his words.[^1]

notes.text: ט. gives Zevachim 9a under the period convention. The named William Davidson vocalized text has Rav Yeimar objecting and Rava answering in the next segment; משיב here is responds, not raises an objection. Both Rav titles are explicit.
